title: Why Jaguars' Trevor Lawrence has legitimate 2026 NFL MVP case, is destined to win one at some point

sources.name: CBS Sports NFL
sources.title: Why Jaguars' Trevor Lawrence has legitimate 2026 NFL MVP case, is destined to win one at some point
sources.description: Across Lawrence's last 17 regular season games, he has 15-plus wins and 45-plus TD. He is only 1 of 10 QBs to achieve that feat
